name: Delegate
description: Run tasks in parallel by other agents, when work splits into parts that each need their own searching or reading (compare options, check claims, survey sources). Tasks see nothing of this chat: give each complete instructions and say what to report back; they can only read. Returns a live card at once; results land on it in a few minutes. Keep it to 2-4 tasks: it costs real money under a daily budget. Not for cited reports (Deep Research) or one quick fact.
author: anything

goal.description: What the whole piece of work is for; every task sees it.

tasks.description: 1-8 tasks, each {"name": "short-name", "profile": "worker" (searches, reads) or "planner" (plans, reviews, writes), "instructions": "..."}; optionally "material" (text to work on) and "tools": false (needs no searching).

then.description: Optional: {"profile": "planner", "instructions": "..."}, a last task that gets every reply, to compare or combine them.
